response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), qualifying AS (SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL) AS above_overall_average FROM status_averages WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL)) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_overall_average, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying;
